# @privacyscrubber/mcp-server (v2.5.5)

> Airplane-Mode-Verified Zero-Trust PII & Secrets Redaction MCP Server for Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Windsurf, VS Code, Cline, Zed, and Google Antigravity. Implements ZTDS RFC v1.0 (`draft-sibiryakov-ztds-protocol-02`) 100% locally in ephemeral RAM with zero outbound network egress.

- **Package Version (SSOT):** `v2.5.5` (`npm`: `@privacyscrubber/mcp-server`, `pypi`: `privacyscrubber-mcp`, MCP Registry: `io.github.moxno/privacyscrubber-mcp`)
- **Homepage & Docs:** https://privacyscrubber.com/pii-mcp/
- **Markdown Docs Mirror:** https://privacyscrubber.com/pii-mcp.md
- **Public Repository:** https://github.com/moxno/privacyscrubber-mcp
- **ZTDS Open Standard:** https://ztds.ai/ · https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-sibiryakov-ztds-protocol/

## Installation & CLI Entrypoints
- **Auto-Install All IDEs:** `npx -y @privacyscrubber/mcp-server install --all`
- **Project Hooks & Rules:** `npx -y @privacyscrubber/mcp-server install --workspace`
- **Google Antigravity Plugin:** `agy plugin install https://github.com/moxno/privacyscrubber-mcp`
- **Stdio Run (Node / Python):** `npx -y @privacyscrubber/mcp-server` or `uvx privacyscrubber-mcp`
- **CLI Guard Bins:** `mcp-server`, `privacyscrubber-mcp`, `ps-mcp`, `pii-masking-run`, `ps-guard`, `agentic-guard`, `privacyscrubber-mcp-install`

## 28 Local Stdio MCP Tools
- **Core PII, Files & Compliance (11):** `audit_context`, `sanitize_text`, `reveal_text`, `stream_reveal_text`, `sanitize_file`, `audit_directory_for_pii`, `redact_file`, `create_default_config`, `generate_compliance_report`, `mark_false_positive`, `check_status`
- **Agentic Guard, RAG & Procurement (12):** `guard_exec`, `guard_read_file`, `guard_git_diff`, `guard_apply_patch`, `create_agent_rules`, `guard_unmask_args`, `guard_session_info`, `guard_session_reset`, `guard_rag_chunk`, `guard_rag_restore`, `export_audit_log`, `generate_procurement_memo`
- **ZTDS Protocol Standard Tools (5):** `ztds_sanitize`, `ztds_restore`, `ztds_audit`, `ztds_info`, `ztds_reset_session`

## Architectural Guarantees
- **Stdio Air-Gapped Transport:** Zero listening ports, zero external subprocessors, and zero outbound prompt/file transmissions.
- **Volatile RAM Token Map:** Surrogate placeholders (`[NAME_1]`, `[EMAIL_1]`, `[API_TOKEN_1]`) stay strictly in local process memory and zeroize on `ztds_reset_session` / exit.
- **Offline License Activation:** Supports free General baseline (`15,000` chars) and offline Ed25519 keys via `PRIVACYSCRUBBER_KEY` unlocking all 30 specialized industry profiles (`PRO $15/mo` or `$110` Lifetime, `TEAMS $99/mo` flat, `Developer SDK $299/mo` or `$2,990/yr`).
- **Companion Developer SDK:** https://github.com/moxno/privacyscrubber-sdk · https://privacyscrubber.com/sdk/
